fullText.simplified:
十四、相信

    小黄猫：
    你好吗？我终于来到猫乐园了，但你不在这儿。我想是我错了，其实你没有来猫乐园，对吗？我走了这么远的路，没想到还是没有找到你。这真是太让人难过了。
    你是不是还在城市里？我准备回去找你了。小白也会和我一起回去。我知道其实小白很喜欢猫乐园，这儿有他喜欢吃的东西，还有好女孩小米，但他还是说要和我一起回去。他真是太好了。
    小米是个很漂亮的女孩。猫乐园是她开的，没想到吧？一个女孩开了猫乐园，照顾着一百多只猫，这是多难的事情。小米有个朋友叫王明，我忘记说了，王明就是向李想买我们的人。他其实不是坏人，他买我们是想把我们送到小米这儿来。王明每个星期天都来猫乐园帮忙，他说小米把自己的钱都拿来照顾猫了，是个大好人，他也想做好人。
    我在猫乐园认识了一只眼睛看不见的大白猫。小米给他吃了药，他的眼睛就好了。这让我想起了我以前在城市里遇到的那只大白猫，她的眼睛也看不见了，那时候我对她说过，我会从猫乐园带药给她。所以，前天我在小米的桌子上拿了一些药，我会带回去给大白猫。希望她吃了药，眼睛也会好起来。
    好了，小黄猫，就说到这儿。明天我和小白就要离开了。虽然回去的路很远，而且经过雪山时可能还会遇到那只大雕，但我一点儿都不怕了，因为我一定要找到你，我相信我能找到你。
    希望你天天快乐！
    想你的饭饭
fullText.traditional:
十四、相信

    小黃貓：
    你好嗎？我終於來到貓樂園了，但你不在這兒。我想是我錯了，其實你沒有來貓樂園，對嗎？我走了這麼遠的路，沒想到還是沒有找到你。這真是太讓人難過了。
    你是不是還在城市裡？我準備回去找你了。小白也會和我一起回去。我知道其實小白很喜歡貓樂園，這兒有他喜歡吃的東西，還有好女孩小米，但他還是說要和我一起回去。他真是太好了。
    小米是個很漂亮的女孩。貓樂園是她開的，沒想到吧？一個女孩開了貓樂園，照顧著一百多隻貓，這是多難的事情。小米有個朋友叫王明，我忘記說了，王明就是向李想買我們的人。他其實不是壞人，他買我們是想把我們送到小米這兒來。王明每個星期天都來貓樂園幫忙，他說小米把自己的錢都拿來照顧貓了，是個大好人，他也想做好人。
    我在貓樂園認識了一隻眼睛看不見的大白貓。小米給他吃了藥，他的眼睛就好了。這讓我想起了我以前在城市裡遇到的那隻大白貓，她的眼睛也看不見了，那時候我對她說過，我會從貓樂園帶藥給她。所以，前天我在小米的桌子上拿了一些藥，我會帶回去給大白貓。希望她吃了藥，眼睛也會好起來。
    好了，小黃貓，就說到這兒。明天我和小白就要離開了。雖然回去的路很遠，而且經過雪山時可能還會遇到那隻大鵰，但我一點兒都不怕了，因為我一定要找到你，我相信我能找到你。
    希望你天天快樂！
    想你的飯飯

sentences.traditional: 小黃貓：
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo huáng māo
sentences.english: Little yellow cat:

sentences.simplified: 你好吗？我终于来到猫乐园了，但你不在这儿。
sentences.traditional: 你好嗎？我終於來到貓樂園了，但你不在這兒。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hǎo ma wǒ zhōng yú lái dào māo lè yuán le dàn nǐ bú zài zhè‘r
sentences.english: How are you? I finally arrived at the cat paradise, but you are not here.

sentences.simplified: 我想是我错了，其实你没有来猫乐园，对吗？
sentences.traditional: 我想是我錯了，其實你沒有來貓樂園，對嗎？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng shì wǒ cuò le qí shí nǐ méi yǒu lái māo lè yuán duì ma
sentences.english: I think I was wrong. You actually didn’t come to the cat paradise, did you?

sentences.simplified: 我走了这么远的路，没想到还是没有找到你。这真是太让人难过了。
sentences.traditional: 我走了這麼遠的路，沒想到還是沒有找到你。這真是太讓人難過了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zǒu le zhè me yuǎn de lù méi xiǎng dào hái shi méi yǒu zhǎo dào nǐ zhè zhēn shì tài ràng rén nán guò le
sentences.english: I walked such a long way, but to my surprise, I still didn’t find you. This makes me really sad.

sentences.simplified: 你是不是还在城市里？我准备回去找你了。小白也会和我一起回去。
sentences.traditional: 你是不是還在城市裡？我準備回去找你了。小白也會和我一起回去。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì hái zài chéng shì lǐ wǒ zhǔn bèi huí qù zhǎo nǐ le xiǎo bái yě huì hé wǒ yì qǐ huí qù
sentences.english: Are you still in the city? I’m getting ready to go back and look for you. Little Bai will be coming back with me, too.

sentences.simplified: 我知道其实小白很喜欢猫乐园，
sentences.traditional: 我知道其實小白很喜歡貓樂園，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào qí shí xiǎo bái hěn xǐ huan māo lè yuán
sentences.english: I know that Little Bai actually really likes the cat paradise.

sentences.simplified: 这儿有他喜欢吃的东西，还有好女孩小米，但他还是说要和我一起回去。
sentences.traditional: 這兒有他喜歡吃的東西，還有好女孩小米，但他還是說要和我一起回去。
sentences.pinyin: zhè‘r yǒu tā xǐ huan chī de dōng xi hái yǒu hǎo nǚ hái xiǎo mǐ dàn tā hái shi shuō yào hé wǒ yì qǐ huí qù
sentences.english: There are things here he likes to eat, and also this nice girl, Little Mi, but he still says he wants to go back with me.

sentences.simplified: 他真是太好了。
sentences.traditional: 他真是太好了。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhēn shi tài hǎo le
sentences.english: He’s truly wonderful.

sentences.simplified: 小米是个很漂亮的女孩。猫乐园是她开的，没想到吧？
sentences.traditional: 小米是個很漂亮的女孩。貓樂園是她開的，沒想到吧？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo mǐ shì ge hěn piào liang de nǚ hái māo lè yuán shì tā kāi de méi xiǎng dào ba
sentences.english: Little Mi is a very beautiful girl. The cat paradise is run by her, can you believe it?

sentences.simplified: 一个女孩开了猫乐园，照顾着一百多只猫，这是多难的事情。
sentences.traditional: 一個女孩開了貓樂園，照顧著一百多隻貓，這是多難的事情。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge nǚ hái kāi le māo lè yuán zhào gù zhe yì bǎi duō zhī māo zhè shì duō nán de shì qing
sentences.english: A girl runs a cat paradise and takes care of over a hundred cats. That’s such a difficult thing to do.

sentences.simplified: 小米有个朋友叫王明，我忘记说了，王明就是向李想买我们的人。
sentences.traditional: 小米有個朋友叫王明，我忘記說了，王明就是向李想買我們的人。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo mǐ yǒu ge péng you jiào wáng míng wǒ wàng jì shuō le wáng míng jiù shì xiàng lǐ xiǎng mǎi wǒ men de rén
sentences.english: Little Mi has a friend named Wang Ming. I forgot to mention, Wang Ming is the person who bought us from Li Xiang.

sentences.simplified: 他其实不是坏人，他买我们是想把我们送到小米这儿来。
sentences.traditional: 他其實不是壞人，他買我們是想把我們送到小米這兒來。
sentences.pinyin: tā qí shí bú shì huài rén tā mǎi wǒ men shì xiǎng bǎ wǒ men sòng dào xiǎo mǐ zhè‘r lái
sentences.english: He is actually not a bad person. He bought us because he wanted to bring us to Little Mi.

sentences.simplified: 王明每个星期天都来猫乐园帮忙，
sentences.traditional: 王明每個星期天都來貓樂園幫忙，
sentences.pinyin: wáng míng měi ge xīng qī tiān dōu lái māo lè yuán bāng máng
sentences.english: Wang Ming comes to the cat paradise to help every Sunday.

sentences.simplified: 他说小米把自己的钱都拿来照顾猫了，是个大好人，他也想做好人。
sentences.traditional: 他說小米把自己的錢都拿來照顧貓了，是個大好人，他也想做好人。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō xiǎo mǐ bǎ zì jǐ de qián dōu ná lái zhào gù māo le shì ge dà hǎo rén tā yě xiǎng zuò hǎo rén
sentences.english: He said that Little Mi spends all her money taking care of the cats and is a really good person, and he also wants to be a good person.

sentences.simplified: 我在猫乐园认识了一只眼睛看不见的大白猫。小米给他吃了药，他的眼睛就好了。
sentences.traditional: 我在貓樂園認識了一隻眼睛看不見的大白貓。小米給他吃了藥，他的眼睛就好了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài māo lè yuán rèn shi le yì zhī yǎn jing kàn bú jiàn de dà bái māo xiǎo mǐ gěi tā chī le yào tā de yǎn jing jiù hǎo le
sentences.english: I met a big white cat that couldn’t see at the cat paradise. Little Mi gave him medicine, and his eyes got better.

sentences.simplified: 这让我想起了我以前在城市里遇到的那只大白猫，
sentences.traditional: 這讓我想起了我以前在城市裡遇到的那隻大白貓，
sentences.pinyin: zhè ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ le wǒ yǐ qián zài chéng shì lǐ yù dào de nà zhī dà bái māo
sentences.english: This reminded me of that big white cat I once encountered in the city.

sentences.simplified: 她的眼睛也看不见了，那时候我对她说过，我会从猫乐园带药给她。
sentences.traditional: 她的眼睛也看不見了，那時候我對她說過，我會從貓樂園帶藥給她。
sentences.pinyin: tā de yǎn jing yě kàn bú jiàn le nà shí hou wǒ duì tā shuō guò wǒ huì cóng māo lè yuán dài yào gěi tā
sentences.english: Her eyes couldn’t see either, and at that time, I told her I would bring her medicine from the cat paradise.

sentences.simplified: 所以，前天我在小米的桌子上拿了一些药，我会带回去给大白猫。
sentences.traditional: 所以，前天我在小米的桌子上拿了一些藥，我會帶回去給大白貓。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ qián tiān wǒ zài xiǎo mǐ de zhuō zi shang ná le yì xiē yào wǒ huì dài huí qù gěi dà bái māo
sentences.english: So, the day before yesterday, I took some medicine from Little Mi’s table, and I will bring it back for the big white cat.

sentences.simplified: 希望她吃了药，眼睛也会好起来。
sentences.traditional: 希望她吃了藥，眼睛也會好起來。
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng tā chī le yào yǎn jing yě huì hǎo qǐ lái
sentences.english: I hope that after taking the medicine, her eyes will get better.

sentences.simplified: 好了，小黄猫，就说到这儿。明天我和小白就要离开了。
sentences.traditional: 好了，小黃貓，就說到這兒。明天我和小白就要離開了。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo le xiǎo huáng māo jiù shuō dào zhè‘r míng tiān wǒ hé xiǎo bái jiù yào lí kāi le
sentences.english: Alright, little yellow cat, I’ll stop here. Tomorrow, Little Bai and I will be leaving.

sentences.simplified: 虽然回去的路很远，而且经过雪山时可能还会遇到那只大雕，
sentences.traditional: 雖然回去的路很遠，而且經過雪山時可能還會遇到那隻大鵰，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán huí qù de lù hěn yuǎn ér qiě jīng guò xuě shān shí kě néng hái huì yù dào nà zhī dà diāo
sentences.english: Although the way back is long, and I might encounter that big eagle again when passing through the snowy mountain, ..

sentences.simplified: 但我一点儿都不怕了，因为我一定要找到你，我相信我能找到你。
sentences.traditional: 但我一點兒都不怕了，因為我一定要找到你，我相信我能找到你。
sentences.pinyin: dàn wǒ yì diǎn'r dōu bú pà le yīn wèi wǒ yí dìng yào zhǎo dào nǐ wǒ xiāng xìn wǒ néng zhǎo dào nǐ
sentences.english: .. I am not afraid at all, because I must find you, and I believe I can find you.

sentences.simplified: 希望你天天快乐！
sentences.traditional: 希望你天天快樂！
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng nǐ tiān tiān kuài lè
sentences.english: I hope you are happy every day!

sentences.simplified: 想你的饭饭
sentences.traditional: 想你的飯飯
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng nǐ de fàn fàn
sentences.english: Missing you, Fanfan

sentence_translations: (14) Believe
Little yellow cat:
How are you? I finally arrived at the cat paradise, but you are not here.
I think I was wrong. You actually didn’t come to the cat paradise, did you?
I walked such a long way, but to my surprise, I still didn’t find you. This makes me really sad.
Are you still in the city? I’m getting ready to go back and look for you. Little Bai will be coming back with me, too.
I know that Little Bai actually really likes the cat paradise.
There are things here he likes to eat, and also this nice girl, Little Mi, but he still says he wants to go back with me.
He’s truly wonderful.
Little Mi is a very beautiful girl. The cat paradise is run by her, can you believe it?
A girl runs a cat paradise and takes care of over a hundred cats. That’s such a difficult thing to do.
Little Mi has a friend named Wang Ming. I forgot to mention, Wang Ming is the person who bought us from Li Xiang.
He is actually not a bad person. He bought us because he wanted to bring us to Little Mi.
Wang Ming comes to the cat paradise to help every Sunday.
He said that Little Mi spends all her money taking care of the cats and is a really good person, and he also wants to be a good person.
I met a big white cat that couldn’t see at the cat paradise. Little Mi gave him medicine, and his eyes got better.
This reminded me of that big white cat I once encountered in the city.
Her eyes couldn’t see either, and at that time, I told her I would bring her medicine from the cat paradise.
So, the day before yesterday, I took some medicine from Little Mi’s table, and I will bring it back for the big white cat.
I hope that after taking the medicine, her eyes will get better.
Alright, little yellow cat, I’ll stop here. Tomorrow, Little Bai and I will be leaving.
Although the way back is long, and I might encounter that big eagle again when passing through the snowy mountain, ..
.. I am not afraid at all, because I must find you, and I believe I can find you.
I hope you are happy every day!
Missing you, Fanfan
